# NextGen HR

> NextGen HR Consultancy L.L.C-FZ is a licensed recruitment agency and HR consultancy in Dubai, UAE, licensed by Meydan Free Zone. It helps employers in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah hire permanent and fixed-term staff directly, and sets up HR policies, employee handbooks and team structure for growing companies. Candidates never pay a fee.

Key facts:
- Legal name: NextGen HR Consultancy L.L.C-FZ
- Founded: 2024, Dubai
- Team experience: more than 20 years of UAE recruitment experience
- Address: Meydan Grandstand, 6th floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE
- Licensed activities: Human resources consultancy (7490.14); Labor Recruitment Brokerage Office Services (7810.97)
- Employers hire every candidate directly, on their own contract and visa
- Email: info@nextgenhr.ae
- Working days: Monday to Friday

## Services

- [Recruitment consultancy in Dubai](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/recruitment): permanent and fixed-term hiring, with every candidate interviewed and checked before the employer sees them
- [HR consultancy in Dubai and the UAE](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/hr-consultancy): HR policies, employee handbooks, team structure and ongoing HR advice
- [Skilled and blue-collar recruitment](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/workforce-recruitment): skilled tradespeople and operations staff, hired directly by the employer
- [Emiratisation recruitment](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/emiratisation): finding Emirati talent for long-term roles
- [Executive search and headhunters in Dubai](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/executive-search): confidential search for senior managers and leaders
